messages:
jena: quick usability review for API Keys page. two things: the primary flow feels cluttered on narrower screens, and reveal / copy affordances are inconsistent. attaching sketch: https://figma.com/file/unique
omar: opened the sketch. propose prioritizing actions: Copy > Reveal > Revoke. Copy should be the most visible control (ghost button style) so users don't rely on reveal unless necessary.
sam: agree on priority. implementation detail: Copy should use navigator.clipboard with an aria-live update: 'API key copied' so screen readers announce it.
nora: accessibility notes: 1) reveal must require a secondary confirmation if the user's last auth is older than 15 mins; 2) use aria-labels like 'Reveal API key, visible for 30 seconds' and announce via polite live region when it becomes visible.
eli: design nit: when revealed show a short progress ring or shrinking pill '30s' so people can see time left. also include a small 'Copy' inside the reveal area.
jena: good. another layout problem: long scope lists push the row height. two options: token chips with an overflow indicator, or single-line compressed summary with a 'details' popover. Which do we A/B?
omar: I'm leaning to the compressed summary on dense rows, chips on detail view. chips are good for discoverability but heavy for lists >6.
sam: accessibility for chips: if chips are decorative, set aria-hidden=true and expose a single offscreen text 'Scopes: read, write, admin' on the row. If interactive, they must be keyboard reachable.
nora: yeah, don't make chips interactive unless we need per-scope actions. prefer a 'Show scopes' button that opens a focusable dialog with full list.
jenA: copy changes for create modal: current text "This is shown once" -> propose "This key will be revealed only once. Save it securely now; you won't be able to view it again." keeps it explicit.
omar: add a short inline 'least privilege' hint next to the scope selector: an info icon with tooltip: 'Grant only scopes needed for this integration.' keep tone friendly.
eli: revoke confirmation: product asked for reasons. suggest a short radio list: 'rotated', 'no longer used', 'compromised', 'other (optional note)'. store reason for audit.
sam: backend note: please add revoke_reason and revoke_note fields to the audit log model. front-end will POST /keys/:id/revoke with { reason, note }.
nora: privacy wording: when capturing notes we must tell users notes are visible to org admins. add a tiny privacy hint in the modal.
jena: mobile: collapse actions into kebab but keep Copy visible as a left-aligned inline button. avoid tiny hit targets. also avoid horizontal scroll for rows.
omar: tiny UI behavior: when the user copies a key, keep a non-modal inline banner 'Key copied. Show in activity log' with a link to audit timeline; dismissible.
sam: keyboard nav: ensure each row is a single tab stop by default (the row container), then arrow keys can move between columns for power users. we should doc both modes.
nora: screen-reader friendly announcement for revocation: when key revoked show polite live region: 'API key "<name>" revoked by <user>. Reason: <reason>'. ensure no PII exposure.
eli: ci-bot: heads-up: the feature-flag keys_ui_reveal_confirmation will gate the confirm flow on staging next week.
jena: thanks all. deliverables: 1) omar to add compressed-summary and chip variants to figma, 2) sam to draft aria examples and clipboard announcements, 3) nora to write confirm wording and privacy hint, 4) eli to stub audit fields and feature flag. I'll update the Linear ticket with acceptance criteria by EOD. :thumbsup:
